title: Balochistan Speakers and Deputy Speakers Salaries Allowances and Privileges Amendment Act 1990

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Speakers and Deputy Speakers Salaries Allowances and Privileges Amendment Act 1990
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT II OF 1990
ACT II OF 1990
BALOCHISTAN SPEAKER'S AND DEPUTY SPEAKER'S (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND
PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1990
Art Act further to amend the Balochistan Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's
(Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary, 15th February, 1990]
No.PAB/Legis.111 (17)/90, dated
15-2-1990.--The Balochistan Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries,
Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Bill, 1990 having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 7th February, 1990 and assented to by the
Governor of Balochistan, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial
Assembly.
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the
Balochistan Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and
Privileges) (Amendment) Act, 1990.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on 1st July, 1989.

Amendment of section 2 of Act V of 1975

ACT II OF 1990

PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1990
Art Act further to amend the Balochistan Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's
(Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary, 15th February, 1990]
No.PAB/Legis.111 (17)/90, dated
15-2-1990.--The Balochistan Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries,
Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Bill, 1990 having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 7th February, 1990 and assented to by the
Governor of Balochistan, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial
Assembly.
2. Amendment of section 2 of Act V of 1975.--In the Balochistan
Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975,
hereinafter referred to as the said Act, for clause (d) of section 2, the
following shall be substituted, namely:--.
"(d)
`maintenance' in relation to an official residence of the Speaker and the
Deputy Speaker, as the case may be, includes the payment of local rates and
taxes, water charges, electricity, gas and fuel charges."

Art Act further to amend the Balochistan Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's
(Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary, 15th February, 1990]
No.PAB/Legis.111 (17)/90, dated
15-2-1990.--The Balochistan Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries,
Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Bill, 1990 having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 7th February, 1990 and assented to by the
Governor of Balochistan, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial
Assembly.
3. Amendment of section 6-A of Act V of 1975.--In the said Act, for
section 6-A, the following shall be substituted, namely:--
"6-A.Telephone--The
Speaker and the Deputy Speaker shall be entitled to telephone facilities at
office and residence at Government expense without ceiling both for official
and private purposes throughout the term of their office and for a period of fifteen
days, immediately thereafter. They will also be entitled to free telephonic
facility while on tour where such facility is available:"

Art Act further to amend the Balochistan Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's
(Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary, 15th February, 1990]
No.PAB/Legis.111 (17)/90, dated
15-2-1990.--The Balochistan Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries,
Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Bill, 1990 having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 7th February, 1990 and assented to by the
Governor of Balochistan, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial
Assembly.
4. Insertion of section 13-A in Act V of 1975.--In the said Act,
after section 13, the following new section shall be inserted, namely:--
"13-A.
Leave Allowances.--The leave allowance of the Speaker and Deputy Speaker
shall be rupees five thousand and rupees four thousand per mensum
respectively."
